shape: a specific, lasting good thing a lucky person has, then a two- or three-word verdict

slides.text: the extra blanket behind the coat waited, so the storm never left me shivering, quiet triumph

caption:
sometimes the things we set aside become quiet heroes
they remind us that hard weeks hide small comforts
send this to the friend who always leaves a spare charger on the nightstand.

#selflovequotes #bekindtoyourself #smallwins
alt: a short note about an extra blanket that kept the writer warm during a storm, ending with a brief verdict of quiet triumph.
